description: This file defines the PdfPage class, which represents a single page within a PDF document. It includes properties and methods for handling page size, media box, rotation, annotations, content streams, and various page boundary boxes, along with initialization and inheritance logic.

classes.name: PdfPage
classes.description: Represents a page in a PDF document, providing functionality to manipulate page size, orientation, content, annotations, and page boundary boxes.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the page to prevent further modifications; resources may be freed afterward.

methods.name: UpdateOrientation
methods.description: Updates the page orientation based on the current width and height.

methods.name: InheritValues
methods.description: Inherits values such as resources, media box, crop box, and rotation from a parent dictionary into the page.

methods.name: PrepareForSave
methods.description: Adjusts page boundary boxes before saving, especially applying any trim margins.

methods.name: GetFontName
methods.description: Returns the resource name for a font, adding it to resources if necessary.

methods.name: TryGetFontName
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the resource name for a font by ID, returning null if not found.

methods.name: GetFontName (overload)
methods.description: Gets resource name of font data, adding a font to the font table and resources.

methods.name: GetImageName
methods.description: Returns resource name for an image, adding it to resources.

methods.name: GetFormName
methods.description: Gets resource name for a form, adding it to resources.

methods.name: WriteObject
methods.description: Serializes the PdfPage object to a PDF writer, adding transparency group if needed.
